record_scope_reconstruction: Four national land-passenger policy phases are distinct from the bilateral passenger railway suspension. Dewele road coordinates cannot stand for the new electrified railway.

source_checks.finding: Decree065 closes land, air and sea for two weeks with goods exception.
Decree074 continues national closure excluding goods.
Article18 expressly maintains land and sea closure for people, exempting goods; later amendment must control endpoint.
Amendment introduces entry screening at land posts and railway; do not equate an airport date with measured passage at every land gate.
Transport ministry explicitly suspends Djibouti–Ethiopia passenger trains while cargo continues.
